text: Vincent Boury, born on 21 June 1969 in Colmar, is a French table tennis player. He competed for France at the 2008 Summer Paralympics in class 2, where he defeated his fellow French teammate Stéphane Molliens to win a gold medal. Earlier, he earned a silver medal at the 1996 Summer Paralympics and a bronze at the 2000 Games. He was also vice-world champion in 1998, 2002, and 2006, and won the team event at the 2002 World Cup.
